I said loudly, “shut up, not everything has to be about you and what you like.” She blushed and didn’t say anything more, my brother didn’t say anything either. But he messaged me after they left saying that this was my expression of “always hating” his wife and that I’m a bad person who doesn’t want her to participate in conversation. AITA?
